note: Both sets contain essentially the same 20 claims with the same values, bindings and quotes; the only differences are ordering and minor wording (A adds the 'Region 3' condition to the 1173.7 rpm rated-speed claim and phrases the damping-loop claim slightly differently). Both correctly capture the key controller facts (47,402.91 N·m saturation, 15,000 N·m/s rate limit, 1° blade-pitch trigger, gain-scheduled PI, rated speed 1173.7 rpm) and read the Figure 7-2 curves consistently. Both also share the same defects: duplicated claims (the 0 N·m variable-speed claim twice, and the Optimal 50,000 N·m @1400 rpm and 0 N·m @0 rpm facts stated under both 'Optimal' and 'Optimal Controller') and legend-label quotes that do not support the numeric curve values. Because the content and the errors are the same, neither set is better.
remarks: Both sets omit several facts stated on the page: that the Region 3 torque logic applies regardless of generator speed, the power-quality benefit traded against short-term generator/gearbox overloading, that the blade-pitch system takes over in Region 3, and the single-DOF drivetrain model / equation of motion (7-5). Curve-point claims (e.g. 20,000 N·m at 850/870 rpm, 43,000 N·m at 1150 rpm) are approximate readings of Figure 7-2 and are quoted with legend labels ('Optimal', 'Variable-Speed Controller') rather than supporting text; treat these as graph-derived estimates. The 'Optimal' vs 'Optimal Controller' naming split creates duplicate facts in both sets.
